bio.text: Bart Hester, a Republican from Cave Springs, represents Arkansas Senate District 33, which includes Bentonville, Rogers, Centerton and Cave Springs in Benton County.
He was elected to the Senate in 2012 and took the oath of office at the start of the 2013 session; his Senate colleagues elected him to two consecutive terms as President Pro Tempore.
Hester was Senate Majority Whip in 2017 and Majority Leader in 2019.

A native of Green Forest, he graduated in 2001 from the Sam Walton College of Business at the University of Arkansas with a bachelor's degree in business management, and his business interests are in real estate and construction.
